name: Pharmacy Summer Program (PSP)
what_you_do: A 5 day camp where you stay on campus. Pharmacists and pharmacy students teach you about pharmacy jobs and how to get into pharmacy school (PharmD). You live in campus dorms.
who_can_apply: High school sophomores or juniors with a 3.0 GPA or higher.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was March 5 to 24, 2026 and closes early if spots fill. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Add a PDF transcript and two short answers of 150 to 300 words each on why you like pharmacy. Contact PharmD@pharmacy.wisc.edu or 608-262-6234.
notes: Check the PharmD events page for the PSP 2027 announcement.
